name: truthroute
description: Cross-model divergence scoring for LLMs. Sends one prompt to multiple providers and returns a divergence score, plus per-provider responses.

auth.note: Only the providers actually requested need a key set.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Send one prompt to multiple LLM providers and score how much their responses diverge.

output.divergence_score: number 0.0-1.0, or null if fewer than 2 usable responses
